conversion: nonnegative actual annual purchase probability divided by top-two-box stated intent; may exceed 1; final simulator probability clipped separately
price_parity_year: calendar year conditional on parity by2050; null means NEVER or UNKNOWN, never zero
ai_cost_decline: fractional annual manufacturing cost decline attributable to AI, excluding baseline scale/learning; not retail pass-through

india_pakistan_categories.dairy_alternatives: all dairy replacements, including milk, cheese, yogurt and other dairy; retail; broader than milk-only simulator
india_pakistan_categories.residual: other in-scope plant-based replacement products; excludes cultivated and fermentation technologies

us_categories: Original source all-category retail plant-based headline; separate retail+foodservice cultivated (petfood included) and fermentation (original inclusions/exclusions), each quantiles
aggregation: Separate model-region panels. Summary quantiles across run medians, not predictive uncertainty and not independent human experts. n_nonmissing discloses conditional parity sample.
public_reporting: held for author/team notification and scholarly review
